note: Docs-critic follow-up pass on top of commit a6e6c50 (working tree has uncommitted changes on top, not committed per instructions): (1) build-docs.mjs checkLinks() rewritten from a page-wide `html.includes(...)` substring test to a set-equality check between the internal hrefs the source markdown's links must produce and the internal hrefs actually present in the rendered <main> body only (captured pre-shell, so it can no longer be satisfied by the shell's own language-switch markup) — verified against all 5 mutations the critic used to break the old check (resolver fallback, fragment-marker-disabled, dir-marker regex, dead .md link, dead non-.md link); every one now fails the build. Non-.md internal links are now dead-link-checked too. (2) README.de.md's 'ARCHITECTURE.md (Englisch, kanonisch)' link now carries a #en marker so it actually lands on the English page instead of silently resolving to German (was previously identical to the very next line's destination). (3) SECURITY.md's language switch now always renders both EN/DE entries; the DE entry on the (English-only) security page routes to ../de/ so a German reader isn't stranded. (4) docs/en+de/deployment.md's WEB_DIR description reworded: there is no compiled server directory (main.ts runs TypeScript sources directly under Node), the default resolves relative to src/server/. (5) docs/de/deployment.md dropped a redundant 'standardmäßig' from the § 4 paragraph (was stacked 3x across 2 sentences).
